children: Most JGBs rise in early Tokyo trade, tracking overnight price gains in U.S. Treasurys. JGBs and Treasurys tend to move in tandem. However, rise in JGB prices may be curbed by prospects for BOJ rate increases. BOJ board member Koeda "warned against excessive caution on rate hikes and noted that Japan's neutral rate likely lies considerably above 1%," Commerzbank Research analysts note in a research report. "The comments reinforced market expectations for further BoJ policy normalization in the coming months," the analysts add. The two-year JGB yield is up 0.5 bps at 1.910%, but the 10-year yield is down 0.5 bps at 2.915% and 20-year yield is down 1 bp at 3.775%.(ronnie.harui@wsj.com)
